fields.description: Greenville brings three- and four-bedroom townhouses to Emaar South, with Lyra and Zora facade options. The homes sit in four-unit groups: three-bedroom houses occupy the middle positions, while four-bedroom layouts have an additional guest bedroom downstairs. A rear terrace extends the ground-floor living space outdoors.

overview: Greenville’s brochure places family recreation around gardens, play areas and outdoor routes. Earthy interior colours and large living areas carry that quieter character into the homes. Nearby community facilities include a nursery, mosque and park, while the wider Emaar South plan includes retail, dining and a golf clubhouse.
research.locationNote: Greenville is within Emaar South in Dubai South, with access towards Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. Wider-community golf and retail facilities should not be treated as private facilities included with every townhouse; confirm access, completion and the selected plot’s outlook.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s page advertises AED 3.2m. The launch fact sheet lists three-bedroom homes from AED 3.2m and four-bedroom homes from AED 3.8m. Property Finder separately displays a market-linked AED 3.4m headline and a sold-out label. These sources do not establish Aliyas stock or a current developer allocation; obtain a dated unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule is 10% at booking, seven further 10% instalments, and 20% on estimated completion. Property Finder corroborates 10/70/20. Historic dates below are the published launch schedule, not a new purchaser’s payment instructions.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment document estimates March 2029 completion, matching Property Finder’s Q1 2029 date. Delivery remains subject to the applicable sale contract and current developer confirmation.

facts.label: Phase size
facts.value: The launch fact sheet identifies 140 homes: 70 three-bedroom and 70 four-bedroom townhouses. These counts describe the phase, not remaining inventory.

facts.label: Lyra three-bedroom arrangement
facts.value: Bedrooms are upstairs, with a main-suite walk-in wardrobe and balcony. The ground floor has a maid’s room and bathroom, laundry, powder room, kitchen and living/dining space; the carport is at the front.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Plan totals include garage and balcony/terrace allocations. For example, Lyra four-bedroom layouts comprise 2,224.58 sq ft suite, 363.07 sq ft garage and 120.77 sq ft balcony/terrace. They are not plot-area figures.
